start: Staff & sign-in, a front desk person with a PIN is signed in on two devices

steps.action: On their row tap 'Sign out everywhere'
user_sees: Sheet 'Sign <name> out everywhere?'
'<name> is signed out of every phone and computer. They can sign in again with a new code. Their PIN stops working too. To get back in, they need a new code; then they set a new PIN.'
Buttons 'Cancel' and 'Sign out'
must_not: No word that the PIN goes too

steps.action: Tap 'Sign out'
user_sees: 'Working…'
Toast 'Signed out.'
The row reads 'Signed out · No PIN yet'
must_not: The person removed from the list
The owner signed out
Members or payments changed

steps.action: The person taps anything on their phone
user_sees: The welcome screen with 'You were signed out of this gym. Ask the gym owner for a new code. If you are the owner, make one on a device where you are signed in.'
must_not: The person carrying on with the old sign-in
Their unsent fees on that phone deleted

start: The owner is signed in on three devices and lost one of them

steps.action: On the own row tap 'Sign out other devices'
user_sees: Sheet 'Sign out your other devices?'
'Every other phone or computer signed in as you is signed out. This one stays signed in. Your PIN is cleared too. Set a new one in “You” above.'
must_not: The button shown when this is the only device

steps.action: Tap 'Sign out'
user_sees: Toast 'Signed out.'
The You card says 'You have no PIN yet…' with 'Set my PIN'
must_not: This device signed out
The old PIN still opening the gym on the lost phone

start: A person is signed in nowhere but still has a PIN

steps.action: Look at their row: 'Signed out · PIN set'
user_sees: 'Sign out everywhere' is offered
must_not: No way to clear the PIN of someone who is signed in nowhere

steps.action: Confirm
user_sees: The row reads 'Signed out · No PIN yet'
must_not: The PIN still working

start: Signing a person out is not offered or fails

steps.action: Look at a person who never signed in and has no PIN
user_sees: No 'Sign out everywhere' button on that row
must_not: A button that does nothing

steps.action: Open the sheet and tap 'Cancel'
user_sees: Nothing changes
must_not: The person signed out

steps.action: Tap 'Sign out' with the internet off
user_sees: Inside the sheet: 'Can’t reach the internet. Check the connection and try again.'; 'Sign out' can be tapped again
must_not: Toast 'Signed out.' when nothing was done

steps.action: Sign out a person another owner just removed
user_sees: 'That person was already removed. We updated the list.'
must_not: A crash or a stuck sheet

steps.action: Sign the person out everywhere, then make a code for them
user_sees: A code sheet as usual
must_not: Making a code refused for a signed-out person

steps.action: They sign in with the code
user_sees: The gym opens; they are offered to set a PIN
must_not: The old PIN accepted

steps.action: The owner opens the page again
user_sees: 'Signed in on 1 device' and, once they set it, 'PIN set'
must_not: Still 'Signed out'

start: A front desk phone is lost with fees taken offline still on it

steps.action: Sign that person out everywhere
user_sees: Toast 'Signed out.'
must_not: The lost phone still showing members from its saved copy once it next reaches the internet

steps.action: The lost phone stays without internet
user_sees: Unknown from the screen: the phone cannot hear that it was signed out
must_not: The owner told the phone is locked when it has not heard yet

steps.action: Sign out the own other devices on a server that does not report PINs
user_sees: The sheet without the line 'Your PIN is cleared too.'
must_not: The own PIN cleared with no word
